# Implementation Plan: Transaction Model (Stream-Based Key/Value Store)

**Branch**: `006-transaction-model` | **Date**: 2026-04-10 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/006-transaction-model/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit.plan` command.

## Summary

Replace the opaque `Block::data` string with a structured stream-based key/value store (MultiChain-style). The `data` field is removed and blocks gain a `std::vector<StreamEntry>` field where each entry has a stream name, key, and opaque data payload. New RPC methods (`publish`, `createStream`, `listStreams`, `getStreamEntries`, `getStreamEntry`) provide stream management and querying. The legacy `addBlock` RPC is removed. Per-node stream permissions restrict local publishing via `config.json`. No serialization versioning needed since there are no existing blockchains.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: C++20 (`-std=c++20`)
**Primary Dependencies**: Boost (Asio, Serialization), OpenSSL, nlohmann/json (vendored `src/json.hpp`), Catch2 (test only)
**Storage**: Boost.Serialization binary chunk files + new index files (`streams.dat`, `stream_index.dat`)
**Testing**: Catch2 unit + integration tests, `make check`
**Target Platform**: Linux, macOS, Windows (cross-platform per constitution §VII)
**Project Type**: Library / daemon
**Performance Goals**: Low-latency query and response (constitution §X); stream index enables O(1) stream lookup, O(key-count) key lookup without full chain scan
**Constraints**: Max entry data size 128 MB; stream names max 256 chars; approved dependencies only (constitution §V)
**Scale/Scope**: 100 blocks per chunk (existing); stream index grows with stream/key cardinality
